parts.prompt: Find the coordinates of the stationary points of the graph of f and determine their nature.

markscheme: f″(x) = 0 ⇒ x = 2 (and f″ changes sign there)

parts.notes: f(x) = x(x − 3)² ≥ 0 on [0, 3], so the integral equals the area.

title: Three ways to solve one differential equation
stem: This question compares an exact solution, a series approximation and a numerical method for the differential equation dy/dx = 1 + y², with y = 0 when x = 0.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: By separating variables, solve the differential equation, giving y in terms of x.
markscheme: arctan y = x + c, and c = 0 from y(0) = 0

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Show that d²y/dx² = 2y dy/dx and find an expression for d³y/dx³ in terms of y, dy/dx and d²y/dx².

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Hence find the Maclaurin series for y up to and including the term in x³.

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: Use Euler's method with step length 0.1 to estimate y when x = 0.2.

parts.label: e
parts.prompt: Compare the estimates from parts (c) and (d) with the exact value of y at x = 0.2.
markscheme: exact tan 0.2 = 0.20271…; series gives 0.20267, Euler gives 0.201
the series is much closer (error ≈ 0.00004 vs ≈ 0.0017); Euler underestimates because the gradient increases across each step
